comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering system?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or when they collect, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS or card machine takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe’s fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract period?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum contract period and no notice period. You can stop any time; the fee is charged monthly in advance, and you keep using the service until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day you will be there.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can really manage. The system uses each dish’s preparation time and the number you prepare at one time.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS with a TSE?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS and has no TSE. How to record online orders in your POS is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab accept?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is} other {The first # months are}} free, with all features.
